problem.title: Minimum Deletions to Make String Balanced

approaches.title: Count violations in each direction
approaches.summary: Count all `a`s occurring after a `b` and all `b`s occurring before an `a`, then return the smaller count. This heuristic is marked wrong because it does not necessarily find the minimum deletions.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces the two-direction violation-counting heuristic; marked wrong.

approaches.title: Try every split point
approaches.summary: Treat each position as a possible boundary between the final `b` prefix and `a` suffix. Track `b`s to the left and `a`s to the right, and minimize their sum.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces the heuristic with a linear scan that evaluates the deletion cost at each split.

approaches.title: One-pass dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Maintain the minimum deletions for the prefix processed so far, along with the number of `b`s seen. For each `a`, choose between deleting it or deleting all preceding `b`s.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Replaces split-point enumeration with a one-pass DP recurrence using constant state.
